title: phlomoides labiosissima
intro: Phlomoides labiosissima, commonly known as Chinese sage, is a perennial plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The health benefits of Phlomoides labiosissima include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
